description: Source-scoped bilingual editorial additions for exactly 100 baseline profiles. Not independent verification or a claim of full completeness.

context.en: UW–Madison uses Eruca sativa in its title and notes an alternative infraspecific name; Garden retains the catalog's accepted Eruca vesicaria pending no identity change.
context.es: UW–Madison usa Eruca sativa en el título y señala un nombre infraespecífico alternativo; Garden conserva Eruca vesicaria, nombre aceptado del catálogo, sin cambiar la identidad.

context.en: Rosette, leaf, and flower-stalk dimensions are UW–Madison species/crop observations, not a cultivar specification.
context.es: La roseta, las hojas y las dimensiones del tallo floral son observaciones de especie/cultivo de UW–Madison, no especificación de cultivar.

context.en: Full sun, light shade, soil, and container notes are outdoor/crop guidance; windowsill mention does not establish hydroponic suitability or grow-light settings.
context.es: Sol pleno, sombra ligera, suelo y recipientes son guía exterior/de cultivo; la mención de ventana no establece aptitud hidropónica ni ajustes de luz de cultivo.

context.en: Successive sowings are an outdoor schedule from the cited regional guide, not a continuous-production guarantee.
context.es: Las siembras sucesivas son un calendario exterior de la guía regional citada, no garantía de producción continua.

context.en: UW–Madison describes leaf removal and cutting above soil for regrowth; Garden frames this as an option, not guaranteed performance in every setup.
context.es: UW–Madison describe retirar hojas y cortar sobre el suelo para rebrote; Garden lo presenta como opción, no como resultado garantizado en todo sistema.

action.en: Use selective harvest, thinning, or removal of damaged tissue as the visible plant requires. Do not turn field spacing into a fixed pod count.

context.en: Leaf size, flavor change, 3–4 week whole-plant reference, and sequential regrowth are UW–Madison outdoor crop guidance; timing varies.

action.en: Cucumber plants produce separate male and female flowers on the same plant. Male flowers commonly appear first; female flowers have a small ovary behind the bloom and need pollen transfer for fruit development. Early flower drop alone is therefore not proof of a plant problem.

action.en: UC Master Gardener recommends cutting rapini before the buds open; its Sonoma County guide gives 10–15 inches as a local harvest cue, not a universal threshold. Cut where the stem becomes succulent rather than tough. Leaves, stems and buds are all part of the harvest; leaving two leaves may allow some resprouting.

Corta donde el tallo deja de ser fibroso y se vuelve tierno. Se consumen hojas, tallos y botones; dejar dos hojas puede permitir que algunas plantas rebroten.

action.es: Los tipos de calabaza de verano pueden crecer como matas cortas o formar enredaderas más largas. Observa el porte real antes de guiar la planta; la fuente no indica que todos los pattypan necesiten enrejado o poda.

context.en: Garden management adaptation; observe the actual plant and do not treat this as a proven companion or system-specific rule.

action.en: UMN Extension includes patty pan among summer squash and recommends harvesting while fruits are tender, before large seeds, hard skin and fibrous or watery flesh develop. It does not specify one pattypan diameter; use the desired culinary size and pick regularly.
action.es: UMN Extension incluye patty pan entre las calabazas de verano y recomienda cosechar antes de que se formen semillas grandes, piel dura y pulpa fibrosa o acuosa. No especifica un diámetro único: elige el tamaño culinario deseado y recolecta con regularidad.
